# Enhanced Report Design Spec — "Nexus Gateway & Fabric Observatory"

**Goal (per user, 2026-07-02):** substantially improve and expand beyond the standard reports in
[RuiRomano/pbigtwmonitor](https://github.com/RuiRomano/pbigtwmonitor) (7 basic gateway-log pages) and
[GT-Analytics/fuam-basic](https://github.com/GT-Analytics/fuam-basic) (tenant-level FUAM pages) —
building **our own branded version** that spans **gateway depth + tenant breadth**, delivered as
**PBIP/PBIR JSON + TMDL** (PBIX generated by the user in Desktop — see "PBIX headwind" below).

## What each reference gives us (and where we go beyond)

| Source | Pages / scope | What we take | How we surpass it |
|---|---|---|---|
| pbigtwmonitor | Logs, Queries, Gateway Profile, Counters, Requests, Mashups ×2 | The raw gateway-log lenses | Add **identity attribution** (who/which dataset), **failure triage**, **network + disk forecast**, **fleet skew** — none of which it has |
| FUAM Basic | Tenant Overview, Timeline, Item Kind Overview, Activities, Capacity/CU, Refresh | Tenant-breadth lenses + the "question rail" layout + KPI-grid + MoM combos + stacked-by-capacity bars | Our own branding/theme; **join gateway ops to tenant context** (e.g. a slow gateway query → its capacity CU cost → its owner) which neither tool does |

## Branding / design system (our own — not FUAM's teal submarine)

- **Name:** *Nexus Gateway & Fabric Observatory*.
- **Theme file:** `starter/report/StaticResources/SharedResources/BaseThemes/nexus_theme.json` (custom palette).
- **Palette:** deep slate `#0B1F2A` bg accents, primary `#00B3A4` (teal-cyan), signal colors — OK `#2FBF71`, Warn `#F4A83B`, Critical `#E5484D`, Info `#4C8DFF`, neutral grid `#243B47`.
- **Layout language:** left **status rail** (dark) carrying the page's headline KPI + the "job to be done" question (our take on FUAM's question rail, but data-driven, not decorative). 1280×720 canvas.
- **Every attribution visual carries the disclaimer chip:** "Best-effort. Not reliable for Paginated Reports, Dataflow Gen1, or DirectQuery."

## Page inventory — 12 pages (vs 4 today, 7 in pbigtwmonitor)

### GROUP A — Executive & tenant (NEW breadth, FUAM-inspired)
1. **Executive Cockpit** — one-screen health: fleet status donut, tenant KPI grid (nodes, clusters, capacities, workspaces, active items, refresh success %, gateway error %, attribution coverage %), 7-day sparklines, top-3 open risks. *Job: "Is anything on fire right now?"*
2. **Tenant Overview** *(FUAM-style, rebranded)* — dense KPI card grid of item kinds (Capacities, Workspaces, Reports, Semantic Models, Notebooks, Pipelines, Eventhouses, Lakehouses…), capacity geo map, MoM consumption + active-users combo. *Requires tenant data (Scanner API / activities).*
3. **Timeline** *(FUAM-style)* — shared date-range slicer; stacked small-multiples: activities, unique users, avg refresh duration, refresh activities, item-creation. *Cross-filters everything.*

### GROUP B — Gateway operations (DEEPENED from existing 4)
4. **Fleet Overview** *(enhanced from current)* — node×cluster×version×status matrix, load-skew CV bars, latency P95 line, + NEW heartbeat-age heatmap by node/hour.
5. **Query & Identity** *(flagship, enhanced)* — the identity join surfaced: queries by user, by dataset, attribution-confidence stacked bar, **match-rate KPI** (from `04_identity_match_rate.kql`), Refresh-vs-DirectQuery split, top offenders.
6. **Failures & Triage** *(enhanced)* — failure-layer bar (gateway/source/network/credential), triage-coverage %, error-signature clustering, OS-event correlation matrix, refresh-history reconciliation.
7. **Capacity & Spool** *(enhanced)* — CPU/mem trend, spool free-space forecast, spool-throughput scatter, **NEW: system-vs-gateway CPU gap** (detects non-gateway host load, e.g. runaway mashup).
8. **Mashup Health** *(NEW — pain #5)* — per-container working-set/CPU, runaway-container flag, container count vs concurrent refreshes.
9. **Network & Bandwidth** *(NEW — pain #7)* — NIC throughput, latency-to-relay P95, saturation flag, spool-size vs transfer correlation.

### GROUP C — Governance & cross-cutting (NEW)
10. **Credential & Datasource Health** *(NEW — pain #10)* — datasource status drift, last-validated age, credential-expiry watch, per-gateway datasource inventory.
11. **Refresh Analytics** *(NEW — tenant breadth)* — refresh success/fail by dataset & workspace, duration distribution, failure reasons, gateway-attributed vs service-only refreshes.
12. **About / Data Lineage & Honesty** — data-source map (which collector → which bronze/silver/gold table → which page), `[Unverified]`/`[Verified]` status legend, attribution methodology, refresh cadence. *Trust surface — nothing in either reference repo does this.*

## New DAX measures required (added to `measures.dax`, "SECTION 11+")

Tenant-breadth (new tables `gold_capacities`, `gold_activities`, `gold_inventory`, `gold_refreshables`):
- `Active Items`, `Capacity Count (tenant)`, `Workspace Count (tenant)`, item-kind counts via `CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(gold_inventory), gold_inventory[ItemKind]="…")`
- `Activities (period)`, `Unique Active Users`, `Activities MoM %`, `Active Users MoM %` (time-intel over a Date table)
- `Avg Refresh Duration (min)`, `Refresh Success %`, `Refresh Failure Count`
- `CU Consumption (period)`, `CU MoM %` *(only if Capacity Metrics data is bridged — flagged [Unverified], see headwinds)*

Cross-cutting:
- `Match Rate %` (mirror of `04_identity_match_rate.kql` at model level), `Attribution Coverage %`
- `Open Risk Count` (offline nodes + critical spool + saturated network + failing datasources), `Top Risk (text)`

## Data model additions (TMDL)

Create the missing semantic-model folder `starter/report/Nexus_Gateway_Observatory.Dataset/` (TMDL) that `definition.pbir` points to. Tables (DirectLake over OneLake gold):
- Existing: `gold_gateway_health`, `gold_query_performance`, `gold_cluster_load`, `gold_dim_gateway`, `silver_triage`, `silver_identity_attribution`, `gold_mashup_health`
- NEW: `gold_gateway_datasources` (pain #10), `gold_capacities`, `gold_activities`, `gold_inventory`, `gold_refreshables` (tenant breadth), plus a **`Date`** dimension (marked as date table) for all time-intelligence.
- Relationships: `Date` → each fact on the hour/day key; `gold_dim_gateway` → health/query/cluster on `GatewayObjectId`.

## PBIX headwind — read this (honest constraint)

**We deliver PBIP/PBIR + TMDL, not a hand-built `.pbix`.** Reasoning:
- A `.pbix` is a **proprietary binary** (OPC/ZIP container wrapping a compiled Analysis Services model + report layout + settings). It is produced **only** by **Power BI Desktop (Windows)** or the **Fabric service** on publish. There is **no supported SDK or Linux path** to compile a valid PBIX from source, and this build environment is Linux with no Desktop.
- Hand-fabricating the binary would be fragile and unsupported — and both reference repos hit the same wall: **neither pbigtwmonitor nor FUAM ships a hand-authored PBIX**; pbigtwmonitor ships `.pbit` templates and PBIP, FUAM ships a `deployment_file.json` the service unpacks. PBIP is the industry-correct, Git-native source form.
- **Your 2-minute path to a PBIX** (either works):
  1. **Desktop:** open `starter/report/*.pbip` in Power BI Desktop (Sept 2024+), fix any DirectLake bindings, **File → Save As → .pbix**.
  2. **Fabric Git sync:** connect the workspace to this repo (Workspace → Git integration), **Update all**, then **Download this report** → `.pbix` from the service.
- We also cannot **validate visual rendering or DirectLake bindings** from here (no Desktop, no live semantic model). Those are marked `[Unverified]` and confirmed in the same pilot that produces the match rate (F2 runbook).

**Other bottlenecks (flagged, not hidden):**
- **Tenant-breadth pages (2, 3, 11) need tenant data** the current collectors don't yet produce — capacity/CU, activities, inventory, refreshables. The report defines the tables + measures, but they render empty until a tenant-extract step (Scanner API + Activity Events + Capacity Metrics bridge) lands `gold_capacities/activities/inventory/refreshables`. That extract is a **new pipeline** (roadmap item), not part of the current gateway collectors. Pages degrade gracefully (blank visuals) rather than error.
- **CU/Capacity Metrics** specifically may require the Capacity Metrics semantic model or FUAM bridge; marked `[Unverified]` until wired.
- **`queryRef`/`visualType` JSON exactness** in PBIR is re-serialized by Desktop on first open (existing R1–R3 caveats apply to new pages too).
